body: Moved from docs/tasks/P1-instant-play-and-worst-bugs.md on 6 Nov 2026 (the task files hold the definition only; how far a task is lives on the board). **Status 2026-10-22: code done, unit-tested; the data-usage measurement is open.** App: a moved scan status no longer makes a full library pass due sooner than `SyncOptions.libraryPassGap` (1 hour; 6 hours on mobile data) after the last one; a pull to refresh ignores the gap; the cheap probe stops asking for a pass inside the gap. The task said 30 minutes: for the owner's 6,700 songs a pass is 8.6 MB, so 30 minutes would be 17 MB an hour against the 10 MB target; an hour gives about 9 MB. Server: the per-song `startScan` is now a fallback after `WATCHER_WAIT_S` (6 s) when Navidrome's own watcher has not listed the new file. Not done: the Android data-usage measurement during a 50-song import on another account; P2's change cursors make all of this disappear.
